title: incident-bot: prioritize runbook autodiagnostics for oncall quicklinks
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Enhances incident-bot prioritization for runbook autodiagnostics and improves oncall quicklink relevance.
description: Motivation: On-call engineers reported that runbook quicklinks surfaced by incident-bot sometimes return low-relevance diagnostics when multiple runbooks match. This PR introduces a prioritization layer that ranks autodiagnostics suggestions by SLO impact, recent incident relevance, and runbook recency. Changes: - Add prioritizer service that scores candidate runbook autodiagnostics (pkg/runbooks/prioritizer.go) - Surface ranked quicklinks in UI and API (web/oncall-ui/src/components/QuickLinks.tsx, cmd/incident-bot/http_handlers.go) - Add configuration knobs for weighting (config/oncall.yaml) - Add unit+integration tests and migration docs Checklist: - [x] Prioritizer implementation with tests - [x] UI changes with accessibility checks - [x] Config defaults added and documented - [x] Staging verification performed Testing notes: Local unit tests + linters pass. Staging e2e showed improved relevance score: median rank of helpful runbook moved from 5 -> 1 for sampled incidents. Performance: prioritizer adds ~2ms median overhead on suggestion endpoint; batching and cache hits mitigate tail. Rollout plan: staged rollout to 10% of oncall traffic for 48h, monitor suggestions_relevance and latency SLOs, then increase to 50% and full. See linked Linear items for evaluation prompts and dataset used.
